recipe: two low sine oscillators (110Hz, 164.81Hz), low-volume mix, limiter
command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=110:sample_rate=48000:duration=900.0 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=164.81:sample_rate=48000:duration=900.0 -filter_complex [0:a]volume=0.025[a0];[1:a]volume=0.015[a1];[a0][a1]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest,alimiter=limit=0.8[a] -map [a] -ar 48000 -ac 2 -c:a pcm_s16le assets/series/ambient-original.wav
